component.name: PDrive Desktop
PDrive Masaüstü
component.summary: A private, native Proton Drive experience for Linux
Linux için özel, güvenli ve yerel Proton Drive deneyimi

description.p: PDrive Desktop is an independent community project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Proton AG.

PDrive Desktop brings Proton Drive to Linux with a fast, native GTK interface. Browse folders, upload and download files, create folders, and run safe one-way backups without routing your data through a PDrive server.

PDrive Masaüstü, hızlı ve yerel GTK arayüzüyle Proton Drive'ı Linux'a getirir. Dosyalarınızı PDrive sunucusundan geçirmeden klasörlerde gezinin, dosya yükleyip indirin, klasör oluşturun ve güvenli tek yönlü yedekleme çalıştırın.
Privacy and safety are built into every layer:
Gizlilik ve güvenlik her katmanda korunur:

ul.li: Authentication is handled by Proton's official browser flow.
Giriş, Proton'un resmî tarayıcı akışıyla gerçekleştirilir.
PDrive never receives or stores your Proton password.
PDrive, Proton parolanızı hiçbir zaman görmez veya saklamaz.
There is no PDrive backend, analytics service, or advertising network.
PDrive sunucusu, analiz servisi veya reklam ağı bulunmaz.
Downloads never overwrite existing local files without an explicit policy.
İndirilen dosyalar açık bir tercih olmadan mevcut dosyaların üzerine yazılmaz.
Remote deletion requires a clear confirmation.
Uzak dosyaları çöp kutusuna taşımak açık kullanıcı onayı gerektirir.

description.p: Adopted the repository-verifiable application ID and added a sandboxed Flatpak build containing the checksum-pinned official Proton Drive CLI.
Added a local transfer queue with safe cancellation and explicit retry, remote backup completeness verification, and provenance-verified user-approved updates.
Enabled real navigation for every sidebar section, single-click folder opening, device browsing, photo timeline support, and section-aware write controls.
Redesigned navigation, polished Proton-inspired visuals, a dedicated application icon, stronger package metadata, and clearer privacy communication.
